description:
Schedule a formal review meeting for an existing high-priority complaint case. 

1. Read the file '~/meeting_details.txt' on the Desktop/Home directory to find the required Date and Time for the meeting.
2. Log in to ArkCase (Username: arkcase-admin@dev.arkcase.com, Password: ArkCase1234!).
3. Navigate to the complaint case titled 'Internal Data Handling Violation - Case #8821'.
4. In the case details, locate the Calendar/Events section and create a new Event.
5. Event Details:
   - Title: 'Oversight Review Board'
   - Start Date/Time: As specified in the text file
   - End Time: 1 hour after start time
   - Description: 'Mandatory review of initial evidence bundle.'
6. Save the event.
